/** Return the 50 most upvoted comments in the last 24 hours **/

SELECT *
FROM [voat].[dbo].[Comment]
WHERE (UpCount) IN 
( SELECT top 50 (UpCount)
 FROM [voat].[dbo].[Comment]
 WHERE CreationDate >= DateAdd(hh, -24, GETDATE())
)
ORDER BY UpCount DESC;
